req.title: Set cookie via query string
req.statement: The system shall set cookies for every k=v pair supplied in the query string of GET /cookies/set.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /cookies/set sets cookies for every k=v pair in the query string and redirects to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive - single and multiple k=v pairs are set correctly; (2) negative - no query params yields no cookies; (3) boundary - single param, empty value, special characters. Mutation resilience requires exact status codes, exact cookie names/values, exact redirect location, and both sides of boolean conditions. The Flask test client must follow_redirects=False to inspect the 302 response headers and Set-Cookie, then also follow to verify /cookies JSON payload.

tests.name: test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No pre-existing cookies in test client
actions: Assert 200 and cookies JSON contains foo=bar
trace: R-HTTPBIN-031: system shall set cookies for every k=v pair in query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?foo=bar', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'
    r2 = client.get('/cookies/set?foo=bar', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    data = r2.get_json()
    assert data == {'cookies': {'foo': 'bar'}}

test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string()

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_set_multiple_cookies_via_query_string():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?alpha=1&beta=2&gamma=3', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    assert 'cookies' in data
    cookies = data['cookies']
    assert cookies.get('alpha') == '1'
    assert cookies.get('beta') == '2'
    assert cookies.get('gamma') == '3'
    assert len(cookies) == 3

test_set_multiple_cookies_via_query_string()

from httpbin.core import app

def test_set_cookie_redirect_status_is_exactly_302():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?x=y', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.status_code != 301
    assert r.status_code != 303
    assert r.status_code != 200
    set_cookie_header = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'x=y' in set_cookie_header

from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookie_key_and_value_are_not_swapped():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?mykey=myvalue', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    cookies = data['cookies']
    assert 'mykey' in cookies
    assert cookies['mykey'] == 'myvalue'

def test_second_cookie_does_not_overwrite_first():
